name: multipeer-gate
description: Standalone Node gates for the n=4 Sereus/Optimystic multi-peer topology: 2 always-on relay drones + 2 relay-only peers. multipeer-gate runs every node in one process; multiproc-gate runs each in its own OS process (or on another host) so replication has to cross a real socket. Both run the same ordered legs -- provenance, control mesh, relay reservation, real dial, cadre authorization, strand cohort, and the distributed-database legs (bidirectional, convergence, concurrency, mutation, isolation control) -- and localize the first blocker.
